Required attribution:
This work is based on "Notre Dame: Indoor+Outdoor (crowdsourced)"
(https://skfb.ly/6RyOK) by Raiz, licensed under Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Project modifications:
* OBJ material file recreated from the two downloaded base-colour textures.
* Import scale and axis conversion adjusted for a room-scale XR experience.
* Texture import size reduced for Meta Quest 3 memory and performance.
* XR teleportation, points of interest, information panels and collision
  geometry added by the Campus Explorer project.
